name: diff-audit-staged-reads-index
description: The staged version of mod.py is branchy; the working tree has since been reverted to the simple version. --staged audits what is about to be committed, so the post-change side must come from the index blob (git show :path) and the complexity advisory must fire on the STAGED code. Reading the working tree instead reported the wrong file entirely -- silent on complexity that the commit does contain.
